name: USPTO PatentsView
tagline: Official USPTO patent search and bulk analytics API for US patents and inventors
description: PatentsView enhances USPTO patent-grant and pre-grant-publication data into research-ready datasets. Its datasets and dictionaries are currently distributed through the USPTO Open Data Portal; PatentSearch API, search, visualization, and support functions have been paused since March 20, 2026 pending reintroduction in updated forms.

auth.details: API key required via X-Api-Key header; self-serve key request on PatentsView site

pricing.free_tier_limits: Not applicable while the PatentsView PatentSearch API is paused; current access is limited to datasets distributed through the USPTO Open Data Portal.

rate_limits: No current limit because the API is paused. The legacy PatentSearch API limit was 45 requests per minute per API key.
use_cases: search US patents by keyword or patent number
look up inventors and assignees for a patent
retrieve citation networks for prior-art analysis
